missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Район' is the nominative predicate noun. 'Тихий' is the agreeing masculine adjective, intensified by 'очень'. A descriptive statement.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Район' is the accusative after 'в', showing destination; this inanimate masculine noun keeps the nominative form. A relocation phrase.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В районе' uses the prepositional form 'районе' after 'в'. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional. A residence statement.
Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Района' is the genitive after 'из', marking origin. 'Соседнего' agrees in the masculine genitive. An origin statement.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'К району' uses the dative 'району' after 'к' to show movement toward. 'Нашему' agrees in the masculine dative. A transit phrase.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of position. 'Районом' is the instrumental after 'за', showing relative position. 'Нашим' agrees in the masculine instrumental. A spatial description.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a quantifier. 'Районов' is the genitive plural required by 'много'. 'Спальных' agrees in the plural genitive. A factual statement.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Районы' is the nominative plural subject of 'растут'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural. An urban-development statement.

missions.phrase: Я был во многих районах города.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Районах' is the prepositional plural after 'во'. 'Многих' agrees in the plural. A summary of visits.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. 'Районами' is the instrumental plural after 'между'. 'Трамвай' is the nominative subject of 'ходит'. A transit description.
